findings.desc: CHK-005:adversarial:3 command is a non-runnable placeholder: `for f in LEGACY_LOGIC_FILES; do test -f $f; done` iterates over the literal string LEGACY_LOGIC_FILES (one iteration, checks a file named LEGACY_LOGIC_FILES which does not exist) and produces no actual verification of the 11 LEGACY_LOGIC_FILES exemption entries. The intent requires confirming each of the 11 files still exists on disk so no dead exemptions mask future regressions. The note claim (missing-files=0) is factually correct but the recorded command cannot reproduce that result — this is a generic-fallback substitution violating the evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command contract.
